lines.en: label halloween9:
scene halloweenparty1
Within half an hour, the Amamiya family’s dojo (Which is apparently a thing they have) goes from mostly empty to completely filled with girls.
lines.zh: 不到半小时，天宫家的道场（看来他们家还真有这种东西）就从空荡荡变得挤满了女孩子。

lines.en: All of the snacks that Makoto and I purchased at various grocery stores throughout the day were replaced by food from a nearby catering company-
lines.zh: 我和Makoto白天跑遍各家杂货店买来的零食，全被附近一家外烩公司送来的食物替换掉了——

lines.en: Which I would be totally fine with if that catering company did not promptly throw everything we’d spent the afternoon preparing directly into the trash.
lines.zh: 如果那家外烩公司没有把我们花了一下午准备好的东西径直扔进垃圾桶，我倒是完全不在意。

lines.en: Also, what the Hell did they even bring to this party?
lines.zh: 还有，他们到底给这个派对送了些什么鬼东西来？

lines.en: I haven’t taken a close look yet, but I’m pretty sure I can see a wedding cake, fried rice, a giant squid, and pancakes from here.
lines.zh: 我还没仔细看，但我敢肯定从这儿就能看到结婚蛋糕、炒饭、一只巨大的鱿鱼和松饼。

lines.en: And that’s not even everything.
lines.zh: 而这还不是全部。

lines.en: : So, Sensei! What do you think of my house so far?
lines.zh: : 那么，Sensei！你觉得我家怎么样？

lines.en: : Pretty impressive, right?
lines.zh: : 挺气派的吧？

lines.en: : It’s the second largest estate in all of Kumon-mi!
lines.zh: : 这可是全 Kumon-mi 第二大的宅邸！

lines.en: : Well first off, I haven’t seen the inside of your actual house yet, just this extra building.
lines.zh: : 首先，我还没见过你真正住的那栋房子里面，只看了这栋附属建筑。

lines.en: : And second, do you really mean to tell me you’re not the richest person in the entire city?
lines.zh: : 其次，你真的要告诉我你不是全城最有钱的人吗？

lines.en: : Well, I don’t really know my dad’s net worth or anything, I just know that the other house is bigger than ours.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我也不太清楚我爸的净资产什么的，我只知道另一栋房子比我们家大。

lines.en: : I think it’s just some snobby rich people that live there or something, though. I’m clearly still humble and lovable and cute and stuff.
lines.zh: : 不过我猜住在里面的大概就是一群势利的有钱人之类的。我显然还是那么谦虚、可爱、讨人喜欢。

lines.en: : As you can see, I have not yet been fully consumed by greed and will accept a smaller wedding if you so desire.
lines.zh: : 如你所见，我还没被贪欲完全吞噬，如果你愿意，我可以接受小一点的婚礼。

lines.en: : I even had a cake brought here for that exact purpose!
lines.zh: : 我甚至还为了这个目的让人送来了蛋糕！

lines.en: scene halloweenparty2
: Hey, wait a second! You said that you just liked the taste of wedding cake better than normal cake!
lines.zh: : 喂，等一下！你之前明明说你只是觉得结婚蛋糕比普通蛋糕好吃而已！

lines.en: : You didn’t say there was going to be an actual wedding!
lines.zh: : 你没说这里要办一场真正的婚礼啊！

lines.en: : Because there isn’t.
lines.zh: : 因为现在还没有。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty3
: Yet.
lines.zh: : 暂时。

lines.en: : How are we still friends? Why do I continue to accept this?
lines.zh: : 我们到底为什么还是朋友？我为什么还要继续忍下去？

lines.en: : You look very pretty, Ami.
lines.zh: : 你看起来很漂亮，Ami。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty4
: Hehe~ Thank you!
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 谢谢！

lines.en: I manage to defuse Ami’s anger in the only way I know how.
lines.zh: 我用我唯一会的那种方式化解了Ami的怒气。

lines.en: It would be problematic for her to kill someone in the middle of a Halloween party, and I haven’t even gotten a chance to mingle with everyone yet.
lines.zh: 她要是在万圣节派对上当场杀人会很麻烦，而且我还没来得及跟所有人打招呼呢。

lines.en: I need to at least choose my favorite costume before this turns into some sort of murder-mystery.
lines.zh: 至少在这变成什么谋杀悬疑剧之前，我得先选出自己最喜欢的变装服。

lines.en: Speaking of which, I’m surprised Ami was able to make something as lavish as what she’s wearing now with what little supplies she picked up from the mall.
lines.zh: 说到这个，我还挺惊讶Ami能用那天在商场买的那么点材料，做出身上这身如此华丽的衣服。

lines.en: Is my [niece] actually talented?
lines.zh: 我的[niece]其实挺有才的？

lines.en: Who would have thought?
lines.zh: 谁能想到呢。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty5
: I agree, Ami. You look adorable.
lines.zh: : 我同意，Ami。你可爱极了。

lines.en: : I’m really surprised you were able to pull that off in just a day.
lines.zh: : 真没想到你居然能在一天之内就做出来。

lines.en: : Aww, stop. You’re probably the only person I know who could pull off looking cute in a full suit of armor, so that means a lot coming from you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别说了。你大概是我认识的人里唯一能把一整套盔甲穿得这么可爱的，所以你这么说让我很开心。

lines.en: : Oh, please. My costume isn’t nearly as impressive. I just had it refitted to suit my body type instead of that of a middle aged man.
lines.zh: : 哎，别这样。我的变装服可没那么了不起。我只是拿去改了尺寸，让它合我的身形，而不是合一个中年男人的身形。

lines.en: : Well it was definitely worth it. It’s probably my second favorite costume here, right next to Maya’s.
lines.zh: : 那绝对值得。这大概是我在这儿第二喜欢的变装服，仅次于Maya的。

lines.en: : Agreed. Maya’s costume is clearly superior to all of ours.
lines.zh: : 同意。Maya的那套明显比我们所有人都强。

lines.en: : I’ve never seen her look this cute before.
lines.zh: : 我从没见过她这么可爱。

lines.en: : I had to have Sana hold me back to prevent me from jumping all over her when she first walked in tonight.
lines.zh: : 她今晚刚进来的时候，我不得不让Sana拉住我，才没有直接扑上去。

lines.en: : Okay, now I’m intrigued.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这下我好奇了。

lines.en: : I didn’t think Maya would be dressed up so...impressively, as you two put it.
lines.zh: : 没想到Maya会打扮得这么……惊艳，按你们俩的说法。

lines.en: : What is her costume and where can I find her?
lines.zh: : 她扮的是什么，她在哪儿？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty6
: Oh, you probably won’t like it, Sensei. It’s kind of a thing only us girls would be interested in.
lines.zh: : 哦，你大概不会喜欢的，Sensei。那种东西只有我们女孩子才会感兴趣。

lines.en: : Probably Ayane and me more than anyone else.
lines.zh: : 大概比起别人，是我和Ayane更感兴趣。

lines.en: : Is it like...an inside-joke or something?
lines.zh: : 是……某种内部梗之类的吗？

lines.en: : Nononono, it’s just-
lines.zh: : 不不不，只是——

lines.en: : Oh, look! Here she comes now!
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧！她这不就来了嘛！

lines.en: I turn around to find Maya and-
lines.zh: 我转过身，看到了Maya和——

lines.en: scene halloweenparty7
: Hey.
: Are you supposed to be me?
lines.zh: : 你是在扮我吗？

lines.en: : My goal was to dress as a clown.
lines.zh: : 我的目标是扮成一个小丑。

lines.en: : I believe I have succeeded.
lines.zh: : 我认为我成功了。

lines.en: : For someone who hates me so much, you look really cute dressed up as me.
lines.zh: : 一个这么讨厌我的人，扮成我的样子居然这么可爱。

lines.en: : You’re just a narcissist. I look average at best right now.
lines.zh: : 你只是个自恋狂。我现在顶多算长得还行。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty8
: I personally think you look better than ever~
lines.zh: : 我个人觉得你比以往任何时候都好看~

lines.en: : Agreed. What are you doing after the party, Maya?
lines.zh: : 同意。派对结束之后你有什么安排，Maya？

lines.en: : Going to sleep. And I do not appreciate the way you two are looking at me right now.
lines.zh: : 睡觉。而且我不喜欢你们两个现在看我的眼神。

lines.en: : Has everyone forgotten that the real me is right here?
lines.zh: : 大家都忘了真正的我就站在这儿吗？

lines.en: : Do I need to put on a shrine maiden outfit to return the favor or something?
lines.zh: : 是不是该换我穿上一套巫女服作为回礼什么的？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty9
: Yes.
: That is sure to teach me a lesson.
lines.zh: : 那肯定会给我一个教训。

lines.en: : Should I run home and grab one for you?
lines.zh: : 要不要我跑回家给你拿一套来？

lines.en: : Umm...I love you, but I don’t think I’d wanna see you in something that...girly, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我爱你，但我不太想看你穿那么……女孩子气的衣服，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’m open to it.
lines.zh: : 我可以接受。

lines.en: : Not exactly what I have in mind when I think about you, but I’m willing to accept you no matter how you dress.
lines.zh: : 虽然不是我心目中你的样子，但不管你穿成什么样我都愿意接受。

lines.en: : Unlike Ami, who has just confirmed that she does not love you enough to let you dress how you want.
lines.zh: : 不像Ami，她刚刚已经证实了，她对你的爱还不足以让你想穿什么就穿什么。

lines.en: : I finally win.
lines.zh: : 我终于赢了。

lines.en: : I never said I want to dress that- Actually, never mind.
lines.zh: : 我可没说我想穿那——算了，当我没说。

lines.en: : I’m going to go talk to some of the others. I’d be a rude guest of honor if I only spent time with you three, who practically live at my house.
lines.zh: : 我要去跟其他人聊聊了。如果我只陪着你们三个——你们几乎就住在我家——那我这个主宾就太失礼了。

lines.en: : I...do live at your house. It’s not ‘practically.’
lines.zh: : 我……就住在你家。不是“几乎”。

lines.en: : Oh no. Sensei is leaving. Whatever will we do to pass the time now?
lines.zh: : 哦不。Sensei要走了。接下来我们要怎么打发时间才好呢？

lines.en: : If you’re going to dress as me you should at least come up with a decent impression or something.
lines.zh: : 既然你要扮成我，好歹也该准备一段像样的模仿吧。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I had one planned. Hold on.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我准备了一个。等一下。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty10
: Hah...
Maya takes a deep breath and prepares herself for whatever sort of mockery she’s about to make of me.
lines.zh: Maya深吸一口气，为接下来要对我做的某种嘲弄做好准备。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty11
: Teenagers are the best.
lines.zh: : 少女最棒了。

lines.en: : Can I hang out in your room?
lines.zh: : 我可以待在你房间里吗？

lines.en: : Why is everyone I know so cute?
lines.zh: : 为什么我认识的人都这么可爱？

lines.en: : I am a horrible person.
lines.zh: : 我真是个糟糕的人。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty12
: Is that enough?
lines.zh: : 这样够了吗？

lines.en: : I think it needs work.
lines.zh: : 我觉得还需要打磨。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty13
: Well...it wasn’t completely accurate, but it wasn’t completely inaccurate either.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不算完全像，但也不算完全不像。

lines.en: : Agreed. She didn’t capture any of his good points. Like how kind and compassionate he is.
lines.zh: : 同意。她一点都没演出他的优点。比如他有多温柔、多有同情心。

lines.en: : Or how big his-
lines.zh: : 还有他的那个有多大——

lines.en: scene halloweenparty14
: Why does everyone like you so much?
lines.zh: : 为什么大家都这么喜欢你？

lines.en: : I have no idea, Maya. But I’ll talk to you later.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道，Maya。不过我回头再跟你聊。

lines.en: : I’m going to go tell everyone how cute I think they are.
lines.zh: : 我要去告诉所有人，我觉得她们有多可爱了。

lines.en: : No, really. Why does everyone like you so much?
lines.zh: : 不，说真的。为什么大家都这么喜欢你？

lines.en: scene black
I walk away from the three of them while Ami and Ayane are still locked in their thoughts and make my way over to the table Rin and Futaba are sitting at.
lines.zh: 趁着Ami和Ayane还沉浸在自己的思绪里，我从她们三个身边走开，朝Rin和Futaba坐的那张桌子走去。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty15
: Oh, uhh, hey!
lines.zh: : 哦，呃，嗨！

lines.en: : Don’t look at me. I’m suddenly embarrassed for some reason.
lines.zh: : 别看我。不知道为什么我突然觉得不好意思。

lines.en: : Rin’s self-conscious about her...increase in chest-size.
lines.zh: : Rin是在意自己……胸部变大了。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta keep my arm like this or it will just be sideboob everywhere.
lines.zh: : 我得这样架着胳膊，不然就全是侧乳了。

lines.en: : I know that’s kind of the point of the costume but it definitely feels weird when there are this many people around.
lines.zh: : 我知道变装服本来就是冲这个效果去的，但周围有这么多人，感觉确实怪怪的。

lines.en: : Especially Chika even though I’m like totally, absolutely, positively over her.
lines.zh: : 尤其是Chika也在，虽然我早就已经完完全全、彻彻底底地放下她了。

lines.en: : It’s okay to still think she’s attractive, Rin.
lines.zh: : 觉得她有魅力也没关系啊，Rin。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty16
: God I want to rip her friggin’ costume off.
lines.zh: : 天啊，我真想把她那身该死的衣服撕下来。

lines.en: : Th-That aside...how are you doing tonight, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 那、那个先不提……Sensei你今晚过得怎么样？

lines.en: : How was your date with the...strange girl from the restaurant yesterday?
lines.zh: : 你昨天跟餐厅里那个……奇怪的女孩的约会如何？

lines.en: : Kaori? It was fine I guess.
lines.zh: : Kaori吗？我觉得还行吧。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t really call it a date, though.
lines.zh: : 不过我倒不觉得那算约会。

lines.en: : We just kind of walked into an alleyway with a bunch of chickens in it and then I collapsed.
lines.zh: : 我们只是走进了一条满是鸡的小巷，然后我就晕倒了。

lines.en: : Actually, why don’t you tell me a little about your night instead? How are you guys doing?
lines.zh: : 对了，不如你跟我说说你昨晚过得怎么样吧？你们俩还好吗？

lines.en: : And what are you even supposed to be?
lines.zh: : 还有，你们这身到底扮的是什么？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty17
: Hipper-class heavy cruiser, Prinz Eugen. Straight outta Germany.
lines.zh: : 希佩尔级重巡洋舰，欧根亲王号。纯正德国血统。

lines.en: : So...you’re a boat?
lines.zh: : 所以……你是一艘船？

lines.en: : Yes.
: Interesting.
lines.zh: : 有意思。

lines.en: : Very.
lines.zh: : 非常有意思。

lines.en: : And I’m...umm...Mami Tomoe from Madoka Magica...
lines.zh: : 而我……嗯……是《魔法少女小圆》里的巴麻美……

lines.en: : I’m sure you don’t know what that is so...yeah...
lines.zh: : 你肯定不知道那是什么，所以……就这样吧……

lines.en: : Well either way, you two look cute.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，你们俩都很可爱。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty18
: Don’t fall in love too hard, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 别陷得太深哦，Sensei！

lines.en: : I’ll just break your heart the second you confess to me on the beach and you’ll go on to spend the next few weeks in inner turmoil.
lines.zh: : 等你在海边对我告白的那一瞬间，我就会把你的心碾碎，然后接下来几周你都会在内心煎熬中度过。

lines.en: : As you can see, Rin is still not completely over what happened back then.
lines.zh: : 你也看到了，Rin还没完全从那件事里走出来。

lines.en: : So much salt.
lines.zh: : 太咸了。

lines.en: : But boats float on saltwater so my costume is a metaphor for me getting over it.
lines.zh: : 不过船是浮在咸水上的，所以我这身变装服就是我已经释怀的隐喻。

lines.en: : Just kidding.
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。

lines.en: : I kinda just want to bang the character.
lines.zh: : 我只是有点想和那个角色上床。

lines.en: : Which doesn’t mean I’m attracted to boats or anything.
lines.zh: : 这不代表我对船有性趣什么的。

lines.en: : Well, I'm also not not attracted to them and-
lines.zh: : 不过，我也不是对它完全没性趣，然后——

lines.en: : Actually, I’m gonna go to the bathroom now. I’ll be right back.
lines.zh: : 算了，我现在要去趟洗手间。马上回来。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty19
Rin quickly leaves the table and walks in a very strange route to avoid crossing paths with Chika, who seems to be absorbed in her phone on a bench in the corner of the room.
lines.zh: Rin迅速离开桌子，绕了一条非常奇怪的路线，只为避开Chika——她似乎正窝在房间角落的长椅上专心玩手机。

lines.en: Yumi is nowhere to be seen, so I’m pretty sure Chika’s still trying to get her to come over here or something.
lines.zh: Yumi不见踪影，所以我猜Chika还在试图把她叫过来什么的。

lines.en: : She’s been staring at her all night.
lines.zh: : 她一整晚都在盯着她看。

lines.en: : I’m not surprised. She was into her for years and Chika is dressed...rather provocatively tonight.
lines.zh: : 我不意外。她喜欢她好几年了，而Chika今晚穿得……相当撩人。

lines.en: : To be fair, I’m sure we’d all dress like that if we looked like her.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，要是我们有她那种身材，肯定也会那么穿。

lines.en: : I think it would be a great idea if you were to all just dress like that anyway.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你们干脆全都那么穿，是个很棒的主意。

lines.en: : If it were up to you, I doubt any one of us would be wearing costumes at all right now.
lines.zh: : 要是按你的意思来，我怀疑我们现在没一个人身上还有衣服。

lines.en: : Ahh, that’s where you’re wrong, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 啊，这点你可说错了，Futaba。

lines.en: : I’ll obviously never say no to nudity, but there’s a certain allure that comes with Halloween costumes that a man simply can not pass up.
lines.zh: : 我当然从来不会拒绝裸体，但万圣节变装服有一种男人根本无法抗拒的魅力。

lines.en: : Girls like costumes too, you know?
lines.zh: : 女孩子也喜欢变装服啊，你知道吧？

lines.en: : It might have been nice for you to get dressed up as something or someone.
lines.zh: : 你要是也扮成某个东西或某个人，说不定挺好的。

lines.en: : Does my standard apparel not excite you?
lines.zh: : 我的日常穿着不能让你兴奋吗？

lines.en: : Not...particularly.
lines.zh: : 不……怎么特别。

lines.en: : It’s more the situations that you put me into that do...
lines.zh: : 更让我兴奋的是你把我带进的那些情境……

lines.en: : But I don’t really want to talk about that surrounded by everyone in class, so...
lines.zh: : 不过我可不想在全班同学面前聊这个，所以……

lines.en: : Fair enough. I was about to go say hi to some of the others anyway.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。反正我也正要去跟其他人打招呼。

lines.en: : I’m sure I’ll see more of you later tonight, though.
lines.zh: : 不过今晚晚些时候我应该还会再见到你的。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty20
: Of course. Are you staying the entire time?
lines.zh: : 当然。你会待到最后吗？

lines.en: : Unless something comes up, yeah. Who knows at this point?
lines.zh: : 不出意外的话会吧。这种时候谁说得准呢？

lines.en: : Well...I guess I’ll see you around then.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那回头见吧。

lines.en: : Feel free to come hang out at our table later if you want.
lines.zh: : 想过来的话，随时欢迎来我们这桌坐。

lines.en: scene black
I’m sure I’ll wind up doing just that at some point.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，自己待会儿迟早会这么干的。

lines.en: But for now, the meeting and greeting (Well, I guess technically just greeting since I’ve met all of these people) must continue.
lines.zh: 但眼下，见面和打招呼（好吧，严格来说只是打招呼，毕竟这些人我都见过了）还得继续。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty21
I stop at the catering table to greet Makoto and Miku on my way over to Chika.
lines.zh: 我去Chika那边的路上，在餐台前停下来跟Makoto和Miku打了声招呼。

lines.en: It appears at first glance that the two of them have already gotten over this morning’s incident, but I’m sure it’s bound to come up again at any moment.
lines.zh: 乍看之下，她们两个似乎已经从今早的事故中缓过来了，但我敢肯定这事随时都会被重新翻出来。

lines.en: : Heya, Sensei! Makoto says the two of us aren’t allowed to be alone together anymore since I gave ya an erection this morning.
lines.zh: : 嗨呀，Sensei！Makoto说，因为我今早让你勃起了，我们两个以后不许再单独相处了。

lines.en: : This is what’s best for everyone.
lines.zh: : 这对大家都好。

lines.en: : I’m sure you understand.
lines.zh: : 我相信你能理解。

lines.en: : Hold on just a second. I had that erection before Miku even came into my room.
lines.zh: : 等一下。那玩意儿在Miku进我房间之前就已经硬了。

lines.en: : I think that’s probably true. I don’t think Sensei would have gotten one from me unless he’s been secretly into boys this whole time.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这话大概是真的。除非Sensei一直偷偷喜欢男孩子，否则不可能因为我才有反应。

lines.en: : As a matter of fact, I don’t believe he is.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我不认为他是。

lines.en: : But still, it would be in everyone’s best interest if you remain at least six feet apart at all times from now on.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，从今往后你们两个最好始终保持至少六英尺的距离，这对所有人都好。

lines.en: : Gotta leave room for Jesus, ya know?
lines.zh: : 得给耶稣留点位置嘛，你知道吗？

lines.en: : Thank you for being the authority on everyone’s best interest, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你担任“什么对大家最好”的权威，Makoto。

lines.en: : I wish you would have said something about this decision during the entire day we spent together so I could clear up any misunderstandings.
lines.zh: : 真希望你能在我们共度的那一整天里提一下这个决定，好让我澄清误会。

lines.en: : Oh. So I misunderstood Miku grinding all over your lap this morning?
lines.zh: : 哦。所以今早Miku在你腿上磨来磨去这件事，是我误会了？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty22
: Hey! Wait a gosh darn second! I wasn’t grindin’ anything! I don’t even know how to do whatever that means!
lines.zh: : 嘿！等等，我的天啊！我没有磨任何东西！我连那是什么意思都不知道！

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Miku. The music is so loud that I can’t understand what you’re trying to say.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Miku。音乐太吵了，我听不清你在说什么。

lines.en: : If you’re apologizing for trying to seduce the teacher before he woke up this morning, then apology accepted.
lines.zh: : 如果你是在为今早老师醒来前试图勾引他而道歉，那我接受道歉。

lines.en: : Just don’t do it again or I’ll have to report it to the[school].
lines.zh: : 别再犯了，不然我就得上报给[school]。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty23
: Hey, don'tcha think that witch costume suits her a little too well?
lines.zh: : 嘿，你不觉得那身女巫装对她来说合适得有点过头了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, she looks gorgeous in it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，她穿起来美极了。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty24
: Hehe~ Thank you~
lines.zh: : 嘿嘿~ 谢谢~

lines.en: : Nonono, I meant like, cause she’s bein’ a real witch right now.
lines.zh: : 不不不，我的意思是，因为她现在活脱脱就是个女巫。

lines.en: : We really didn’t do anything weird and I keep thinkin’ she’s gonna shank me when I’m not payin’ attention.
lines.zh: : 我们真的什么奇怪的事都没做，而且我总觉得我一不留神她就会捅我一刀。

lines.en: : And Karin’s busy tonight so I can’t even hire a bodyguard.
lines.zh: : 而且 Karin 今晚很忙，我连个保镖都雇不到。

lines.en: : Karin is strong but I don’t think she’d be willing to fight off anyone who actually wants to stab you, Miku.
lines.zh: : Karin 是很强，但我不觉得她愿意替你打退任何真想捅你的人，Miku。

lines.en: : Just run away if she tries anything.
lines.zh: : 她要是动手，你就跑。

lines.en: : Or better yet, fly. You have wings tonight.
lines.zh: : 或者最好是飞。今晚你可是有翅膀的。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty25
: Holy heck! Ya don’t think they actually work, do ya?!
lines.zh: : 我——靠！你该不会觉得那翅膀真能飞吧？！

lines.en: : Please do not jump off of anything high trying to find out. I want to clarify that since I’m never sure what you’re going to take seriously or not.
lines.zh: : 千万别为了验证从高处往下跳。这话我先说明白，因为我永远拿不准你会不会当真。

lines.en: : Speaking of taking things seriously, Sensei, there’s something I’d like to discuss with you later if you get some time.
lines.zh: : 说到当真，Sensei，等你有时，我有件事想跟你谈谈。

lines.en: : Obviously, you need to say hello to everyone first, so just come see me whenever you have an extra moment.
lines.zh: : 显然，你得先跟所有人打招呼，所以有空的时候来找我一下就行。

lines.en: : I can assure you it will be worth your time.
lines.zh: : 我向你保证，绝对值得你花这个时间。

lines.en: : Huh? Oh, yeah. I can do that.
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦，好。没问题。

lines.en: : Great.
lines.zh: : 很好。

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse Miku and me, I’d like to continue lecturing her about the risks that come with sex before marriage.
lines.zh: : 那么，请允许我和Miku告退，我要继续给她讲婚前性行为的风险。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty26
: AAAAAHHH!!! JUST KILL ME ALREADY!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊！！！干脆杀了我吧！！！！

lines.en: scene black
I take a step past Miku as she crumbles under Makoto’s clutches and falls to the ground.
lines.zh: 我从在Makoto魔掌下崩溃、瘫倒在地的Miku身边迈了过去。

lines.en: Fortunately, I am far too busy to involve myself in discussions about pre-marital sex and have decided to talk to Chika instead.
lines.zh: 幸好，我忙得根本没空掺和关于婚前性行为的讨论，决定还是去跟Chika说话。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty27
Now this is a rare sight.
lines.zh: 这可真是罕见的一幕。

lines.en: Chika sits by herself without even a semblance of a smile on her face.
lines.zh: Chika独自坐着，脸上连一丝笑意都没有。

lines.en: Maybe the thing with Yumi is hitting her harder than I thought it would.
lines.zh: 也许Yumi的事对她的打击比我想象的要大。

lines.en: I know she cares about her a lot, but I didn’t think she’d get this offended by her just...doing what she wants to do when that’s always what Yumi does in the first place.
lines.zh: 我知道她很在乎她，但我没想到她会因为Yumi只是……做自己想做的事就难受成这样，毕竟Yumi本来一直都是那样的人。

lines.en: : Hey. What are you up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿。你在忙什么呢？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty28
: Oh, hey!
lines.zh: : 哦，嘿！

lines.en: : Just texting and stuff.
lines.zh: : 就发发短信什么的。

lines.en: : Did I look like a loner over here?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像个孤零零的人吗？

lines.en: : Come over to keep me company?
lines.zh: : 过来陪陪我？

lines.en: : I guess you could say that.
lines.zh: : 也可以这么说。

lines.en: : Talking to Yumi, I’m guessing?
lines.zh: : 是在跟Yumi发消息吧？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty29
: Yeah. I feel really bad.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我心里特别过意不去。

lines.en: : I honestly might get out of here and just go hang out with her at my place if I can’t get her to come.
lines.zh: : 说实话，要是没法把她叫来，我可能干脆离开这儿，回我家跟她待着算了。

lines.en: : She always winds up having to spend her birthday alone and I shouldn’t be letting stuff like that happen when I’m really the only friend she has.
lines.zh: : 到头来她总是得一个人过生日，而既然我真的是她唯一的朋友，我就不该让这种事继续发生。

lines.en: : Like, even when she used to chill with all of those guys her dad knew, they never really paid much attention to her.
lines.zh: : 比方说，就算她以前跟她爸认识的那些男生混在一起时，他们也从来没真正关心过她。

lines.en: : She’s like a lost puppy just lookin’ around for a mama-dog and-
lines.zh: : 她就像一只迷路的小狗，四处张望找狗妈妈，然后——

lines.en: scene halloweenparty30
: Oh no! Now I’m thinking of Yumi as an actual puppy and it’s even more sad!
lines.zh: : 完蛋！现在我真的把Yumi想成一只小狗了，更惨了！

lines.en: : Do you have a handkerchief I could borrow or something? I don’t wanna cry and ruin my makeup.
lines.zh: : 你有手帕能借我吗什么的？我不想哭花了妆。

lines.en: : I am definitely not the type to carry a handkerchief around. Sorry, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我绝对不是那种随身带手帕的人。抱歉，Chika。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty31
: It’s fine. If I strain my eyes I can probably just trap my tears with my eyelids and prevent them from running down my face or whatever.
lines.zh: : 没事。要是我使劲瞪着眼睛，大概就能用眼皮把眼泪兜住，不让它们流下来什么的。

lines.en: : That...is one of the saddest things I’ve ever heard.
lines.zh: : 那……是我听过最可怜的话之一。

lines.en: : Sadder than spending your birthday and Halloween alone at the same time?
lines.zh: : 比一个人同时过生日和万圣节还可怜吗？

lines.en: : At least it’s not Christmas.
lines.zh: : 至少不是圣诞节。

lines.en: : Heh...Yeah, I guess you’ve got a point there.
lines.zh: : 嘿……是啊，你说得有道理。

lines.en: : I was just hoping that after the beach thing, she’d realize that not everybody hates her and that it’s okay to show up to group activities and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我只是希望，海边那件事之后，她能意识到不是所有人都讨厌她，来参加集体活动也没什么大不了的。

lines.en: : To be fair, she didn’t make much of an effort at the beach either.
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，她在海边也没怎么努力过。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty32
: She never makes much of an effort anywhere. That’s why you and me have to try so hard to protect her.
lines.zh: : 她在任何地方都不会多努力。所以才需要你和我这么拼命地保护她。

lines.en: I’m not sure how it falls on me to protect Yumi when she’s capable of making her own decisions- even if more than half of those decisions are wrong.
lines.zh: Yumi明明有能力自己做决定——哪怕她做的决定有一半以上是错的——我不太明白保护她这件事怎么就落到我头上了。

lines.en: But I guess it wouldn’t hurt going out of my way for her every once in a while.
lines.zh: 不过偶尔为她破个例，大概也没什么坏处。

lines.en: : Hey, why don’t you tell her that I’ll stop covering for all of her absences if she doesn’t show up to the party for at least an hour?
lines.zh: : 嘿，要不你告诉她，如果她连一个小时的派对都不肯露面，我就不帮她瞒着翘课的事了？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty33
: Ooh! That actually might work! Great idea, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦！这说不定真管用！好主意，Sensei！

lines.en: scene halloweenparty34
Chika begins typing out a message to Yumi at light-speed and then pauses for a few seconds after tapping what I assume is the ‘send’ button.
lines.zh: Chika以光速开始给Yumi打字，在我猜是按下“发送”键之后，又停顿了几秒。

lines.en: : Any response yet?
lines.zh: : 有回复了吗？

lines.en: : Just got one.
lines.zh: : 刚收到。
: ……然后呢？

lines.en: : She says “Fuck you.”
lines.zh: : 她说“操你的”。

lines.en: : Oh.
scene halloweenparty35
: I think it’s a good “Fuck you,” though.
lines.zh: : 不过我觉得，这是一句善意的“操你的”。

lines.en: : There is only one good way to use those words together and I am almost positive it is not what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 这两个字凑在一起只有一种好的用法，而我几乎可以确定你说的不是那个。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty36
: Heh.
: Wait, is it?
lines.zh: : 等等，是那个吗？

lines.en: : Of course not. But I thought about it for a second and now I’m trying to figure out if I should be jealous of Yumi or not for doing stuff with you in my imagination.
lines.zh: : 当然不是。不过我刚刚想了一下，现在正在琢磨，我到底该不该为Yumi在我的想象里跟你做的事而吃醋。

lines.en: : Please tell me more about what’s happening in your imagination, Chika.
lines.zh: : 请务必跟我多说说你想象里都发生了什么，Chika。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty37
: No thanks~ Gotta focus on getting my friend here.
lines.zh: : 不要~ 我得专心把我朋友弄过来。

lines.en: : Maybe you should go talk to whoever is in the dolphin costume? She’s been looking at you all night.
lines.zh: : 你不如去跟那个穿海豚装的人说说？她一整晚都在看你。

lines.en: : The dolphin costume? That’s Sana.
lines.zh: : 海豚装？那是Sana。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty38
: Wait, Sana is in the dolphin costume?! That’s like, totally unexpected.
lines.zh: : 等等，Sana穿的是海豚装？！这、这也太出乎意料了吧。

lines.en: : And why is she staring at you so much if that’s true?
lines.zh: : 而且如果是她，她为什么一直盯着你看？

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to let you know if I find out.
lines.zh: : 要是我查出来了，一定告诉你。

lines.en: scene black
I step away from Chika and begin heading to my next target.
lines.zh: 我从Chika身边走开，朝下一个目标走去。

lines.en: I do hope she’ll be able to convince Yumi to come.
lines.zh: 我真希望她能把Yumi说服过来。

lines.en: I’m not sure if my strategy will work, but it’s definitely something I can imagine a tsundere falling for.
lines.zh: 我不确定我的策略管不管用，但这绝对是那种傲娇会中招的招数。

lines.en: If she even is a tsundere and not just some girl who literally wants to rip my dick off.
lines.zh: 如果她真的是傲娇，而不是一个字面意义上想把我鸡巴扯下来的女生的话。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty39
: I can’t tell if I like Halloween or not.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己喜不喜欢万圣节。

lines.en: : Sana, did you need something?
lines.zh: : Sana，你找我有什么事吗？

lines.en: : Chika informed me that someone in a dolphin costume has been staring at me the entire night.
lines.zh: : Chika告诉我，有个穿海豚装的人一整晚都在盯着我。

lines.en: : And seeing as there are no other dolphin costumes to be found-
lines.zh: : 鉴于现场找不到别的海豚装——

lines.en: scene halloweenparty40
: Well you’re just a regular Sherlock Holmes, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 哟，你可真是当代的夏洛克·福尔摩斯啊。

lines.en: : Can it, Maya.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，Maya。

lines.en: : U-Um...Y-Yes!
lines.zh: : 那、那个……是、是的！

lines.en: : I...don’t really know what to do at...p-parties...
lines.zh: : 我……不太知道在……派、派对上该做什么……

lines.en: : But Maya came to sit with me right before you showed up, so...
lines.zh: : 不过在你出现之前，Maya过来陪我坐了，所以……

lines.en: : That’s right. Your assistance is no longer needed. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 没错。已经不需要你帮忙了。再见。

lines.en: : Are you friends with Maya now, Sana?
lines.zh: : 你现在和Maya是朋友了，Sana？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty39
: Now? Were we not friends previously?
lines.zh: : 现在？我们之前不是朋友吗？

lines.en: : W-We were?! But we’ve never really...talked alone before...
lines.zh: : 我、我们是吗？！可我们从来没有真正……单独说过话……

lines.en: : You don’t really need to talk in order to be friends with someone, do you?
lines.zh: : 和人做朋友，也不一定非要说话吧？

lines.en: : I think you...kind of do?
lines.zh: : 我觉得……大概还是需要的？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty40
: Interesting. I suddenly have significantly less friends than I thought I did.
lines.zh: : 有意思。这么说来，我突然比自己以为的少了很多朋友。

lines.en: : How sad.
lines.zh: : 真可悲。

lines.en: : A new friend...
lines.zh: : 新朋友……

lines.en: scene halloweenparty39
: Correct. And as your friend, is it okay if I ask how long you intend on staying inside of the dolphin costume for?
lines.zh: : 正确。那么作为你的朋友，我可以问一下，你打算在那身海豚装里待多久吗？

lines.en: : It has to be hot in there, right?
lines.zh: : 里面肯定很热吧？

lines.en: : Yes but...I look silly with my hair up so...
lines.zh: : 是的，但是……我把头发扎起来看起来很傻，所以……

lines.en: : It’s kind of embarrassing...not being inside of the dolphin.
lines.zh: : 不在海豚里的话……有点难为情……

lines.en: : Why wear a dolphin costume in the first place?
lines.zh: : 那你一开始为什么要穿海豚装？

lines.en: : Also, what is Sexy Land?
lines.zh: : 还有，性感乐园是什么？

lines.en: : I...still haven’t had the heart to look it up...
lines.zh: : 我……还没鼓起勇气去查……

lines.en: scene halloweenparty41
: Then I will. I’m kind of curious now.
lines.zh: : 那我来查。我现在有点好奇了。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, I definitely don’t like that.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我完全不喜欢那个。

lines.en: : What...is it exactly?
lines.zh: : 那……到底是什么？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty42
Maya holds up her phone to Sana, who takes...quite a long time looking it over.
lines.zh: Maya把手机举到Sana面前，Sana盯着看了……相当长的一段时间。

lines.en: : Can I see next?
lines.zh: : 能让我也看看吗？

lines.en: : Absolutely not.
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。

lines.en: : You know I can just look it up myself, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我自己也能查吧？

lines.en: : Feel free. I will not be showing you this.
lines.zh: : 请便。但这个我不会给你看。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty43
: Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty44
: I need to go think about some things...
lines.zh: : 我需要去想一些事情……

lines.en: scene halloweenparty45
Sana leaves the table and suddenly, Maya and I are alone together at a party.
lines.zh: Sana离开了桌子，突然之间，在一场派对上，我和Maya单独相处了。

lines.en: That is not something I ever expected to happen.
lines.zh: 我从没想过会发生这种事。

lines.en: : I bet we look very strange right now to anyone who looks over here.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，现在任何人往这边看，都会觉得我们很奇怪。

lines.en: : We’d look significantly less strange if we weren’t matching.
lines.zh: : 要是我们没穿情侣装，就没那么奇怪了。

lines.en: : And we’d look even stranger if you had decent fashion sense.
lines.zh: : 要是你有点像样的时尚品味，我们会更奇怪。

lines.en: : Thankfully, your style carries the same amount of excitement as an order of plain toast, so we at least look generic.
lines.zh: : 幸好你的穿衣风格和一盘白吐司一样无趣，所以我们至少看起来还算普通。

lines.en: : You say that, but I really do think you look cute.
lines.zh: : 你嘴上这么说，可我是真觉得你很可爱。

lines.en: : Stop saying that. It’s weird.
lines.zh: : 别再说了。很奇怪。

lines.en: : Looking cute was not the point. I want to annoy you.
lines.zh: : 我可不是为了可爱才这么穿的。我是想惹你烦。

lines.en: : You’re not slipping into the tsundere role for real this time, are you?
lines.zh: : 你这次不是真的要滑进傲娇角色了吧？

lines.en: : No, I just genuinely want to annoy you. I mean it.
lines.zh: : 不是，我就是真心想惹你烦。我是认真的。

lines.en: : Why do I feel like you’re being serious?
lines.zh: : 为什么我觉得你是认真的？

lines.en: scene halloweenparty46
: Because...I am?...
lines.zh: : 因为……我确实是？……

lines.en: : Sure, Maya.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Maya。

lines.en: : What do you mean “Sure, Maya?”
lines.zh: : “是啊，Maya”是什么意思？

lines.en: : I am Maya and I am sure.
lines.zh: : 我就是Maya，而且我很确定。

lines.en: : If I wanted you to think I was cute I’d just wear the same things I always wear. That’s the most effective tactic.
lines.zh: : 如果我想让你觉得我可爱，我就穿平时那些衣服了。那才是最有效的手段。

lines.en: : Sure, Maya.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Maya。

lines.en: scene halloweenparty47
: I hate you so much.
lines.zh: : 我真是恨死你了。

lines.en: scene black
I pull my chair out and turn around to see if I can figure out where Sana’s gone, but it seems she’s already disappeared.
lines.zh: 我把椅子拉开，转过身想看看Sana去哪儿了，但她似乎已经不见了。

lines.en: That being said, there are only two students I have yet to see.
lines.zh: 话虽如此，我还有两个学生没见到。

lines.en: Well, other than the one who hasn’t shown up, that is.
lines.zh: 好吧，除了那个还没露面的。

lines.en: I walk past Ami and Ayane on my way to the opposite side of the room, patting each of them on the head at the same time so they don’t kill each other, and finally stop at Molly and Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 我路过Ami和Ayane，走向房间的另一侧，同时拍了拍她们俩的头以防她们互相残杀，最后在Molly和Tsuneyo面前停下。
